newsitem.title: USA: CUNO Inc says names Mark Kachur president.
newsitem.headline: CUNO Inc says names Mark Kachur president.

text.p: CUNO Inc said on Friday it had named Mark Kachur president and chief operating officer and Ronald Drabik senior vice president, chief financial officer, secretary and treasurer.
Kachur was president and chief executive officer of Biotage Inc from 1992 to 1994, CUNO said in a statement.
As president, Kachur would be responsible for all aspects of CUNO's operations, including eight manufacturing facilities in the United States, France, Japan, Australia and Singapore, CUNO said.
Drabik would play a key role in establishing CUNO as an independent public company, developing analyst coverage, market makers and investor relations, the company said.
